title: Before the front
briefing: A storm front is rolling in from the sea and will hit within hours. The coast is fertile, but we don't know what lives in the tidal zone. Find out before the weather closes in.
goal: Take a sample of the tidal mat and place a relay in the lee of the ridge.

main_sample.label: The Tidal Mat
main_sample.text: Algae and small shellfish — nothing that means us harm. The water can be cleaned with simple filters, and the ridge takes the worst of the wind.

risk_sample.label: The Reef Edge
risk_sample.text: The waves break over the reef. The light meter shows how much the clouds steal: solar power alone won't be enough here.

routes.label: Over the ridge
routes.description: Steeper and longer, but sheltered from the wind.

routes.label: Along the beach
routes.description: Straight along the waterline — right in the storm front's path.

evacuation: The wind tears at the suit, and energy is falling fast. ARK: “Find shelter and head for the lander. We'll come back when the front has passed.”

findings.main: Pelagos: The tidal zone is alive, but harmless. Build in the lee of the ridge.
findings.risk: Pelagos: The clouds take much of the sun. Batteries will be necessary.
findings.relay: Pelagos: The relay sits in the lee and holds the link through the storms.
